alice.chen.name: Alice Chen
alice.chen.bio: Works at Northstar. Lives in Seattle, Washington. Will fix your bike, will not fix your printer.

bob.martinez.name: Bob Martinez
bob.martinez.bio: Northstar. Sunday league goalkeeper, Tuesday trivia, Thursday regrets. Ask me about my sourdough starter (his name is Kevin).

carol.nakamura.name: Carol Nakamura
carol.nakamura.bio: Engineering manager at Northstar. Mom of two, one of them a dog. Ballard.

maya.okafor.name: Maya Okafor
maya.okafor.bio: Nurse at Swedish. Marathon in training, forever. Alice's college roommate and still her emergency contact.

jonah.reyes.bio: Bob's brother-in-law. Contractor. If you are reading this, your deck is probably fine.

hana.sato.bio: Carol's neighbour, retired librarian, current pickleball menace.

p-3103.author: carol.nakamura
p-3103.text: We shipped the big thing at work this week. Two years. I have taken Friday off to sit on the deck and not look at a laptop. Rosa, I will be over for tomatoes.

p-3104.author: rosa.lindqvist
p-3104.text: Congrats Carol!! Bag is on the porch. Bring the dog.

p-3105.author: alice.chen
p-3105.text: Yes we did. Proudest I have been of a piece of software. Also I am never doing that again until next time.

p-3108.author: maya.okafor
p-3108.text: Shared to my whole floor at work. Half of them live in Fremont. He will turn up, they always do.

p-3109.author: bob.martinez
p-3109.text: Kevin the sourdough starter turns 3 today. He has outlived two phones and one relationship. Cake is being made from him, which feels dark, but that is the deal we have.

p-3116.author: alice.chen
p-3116.text: Best outcome. Nimbus you absolute menace.

p-3119.author: maya.okafor
p-3119.text: Happy birthday to Alice Chen, who once drove me to the airport at 4am and did not complain even a little (she complained a medium amount). Love you. Dinner is on me this year, no arguments.

p-3120.author: carol.nakamura
p-3120.text: Happy birthday Alice! The team got you a cake shaped like a render frame. It is a rectangle. We tried.

p-3121.author: bob.martinez
p-3121.text: Happy birthday. Kevin says hi. There is a loaf with your name on it, literally, I scored it in.

p-3122.author: alice.chen
p-3122.text: Thank you all. 4am airport runs are the true measure of friendship and Maya I would do it again. Bob the loaf is beautiful. Carol the rectangle made me cry a little.

p-3124.text: Pickleball, Gilman Park, Wednesday 6pm. Beginners welcome. Carol Nakamura I know you said you would come and I have it in writing.

p-3125.author: carol.nakamura
p-3125.text: I did say that. I will be there. I will lose. Bringing the dog as moral support.

p-3129.author: bob.martinez
p-3129.text: Sunday league result: we lost 4-1, I saved a penalty, and I am choosing to remember only the second part.

p-3110.author: jonah.reyes
p-3110.text: Happy birthday Kevin. Bring a loaf Sunday and I will look at your gutter for free.

messages.text: Ok group chat without Alice (jk she is in here, hi Alice). Dinner Saturday 7pm, the Thai place on Market. I booked for four.
In. Can we make it 7:30? Pickleball is Wednesday not Saturday but I am pre-emptively tired.
7:30 works. I am bringing bread whether or not the restaurant allows it.
You are all ridiculous and I love you. 7:30. Bob, ask first.
Hi Carol, Hana said you might be able to bring folding tables Sunday? We have two and need four.
Yes, I have two in the garage. Jonah Reyes has a truck and offered to haul, I will loop him in. What time do you want them?
8am would be perfect. Thank you! Buns on us.
